label: Where it is
value: On the Mahodand Lake jeep road, about half an hour before the lake
quote: The waterfall comes just half hour before Mahudand Lake.

label: Distance from Kalam
quote: It is about 46 km from Kalam and 343 km from Islamabad via Swat Motorway

label: Time from Islamabad
value: About four and a half hours by car, bus or jeep
quote: Through a car, bus and Jeep you can reach Mighty 22 fall (Kalam) from Islamabad in Four and a half hours.

label: Also known as
quote: which is also known by Matiltan Waterfall and Ushu Waterfall

label: Best time to see it
value: Summer, when a visitor found it at its finest
quote: During summers, these falls transform into an extraordinary wonder that will remain etched in your mind forever.

label: What to expect
value: A stop on the way, often unplanned
quote: People enjoy the waterfall while going to Mahudand as it comes unexpected on the way.
